=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/claude_fixer_pending_checks.py:527-534 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: check_review_runs() trusts titled workflow_dispatch runs as reviews for the PR named in display_title without verifying that head_branch is the trusted default branch.
  WHY: A PR-controlled workflow can forge a successful [pr:<N>] title; the run can then supersede a real failed review and enable auto-merge.
- scripts/claude_fixer_pending_checks.py:533-534 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: Failed untitled workflow_dispatch runs are added to untitled_failures without restricting them to the default branch.
  WHY: The global workflow_dispatch listing includes runs from all branches, so an unrelated or PR-controlled branch failure can block pending-checks auto-merge for other PRs.
- scripts/claude_fixer_pending_checks.py:548-552 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The untitled_failures check returns review_superseded unconditionally, even when a newer bound review for the PR succeeded.
  WHY: An older untitled failure still blocks auto-merge after a newer successful review; all reviewers classify this as MAJOR.
- scripts/claude_fixer_pending_checks.py:452, 656-659 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: check_review_runs() does not accept default_branch, and evaluate() does not pass its already-resolved default branch to that function.
  WHY: The function cannot enforce the trusted-branch check on dispatch runs; severity disagreement: BLOCKER and MAJOR were reported, so the highest severity is used.

=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- scripts/claude_fixer_pending_checks.py: lines 527-534, specifically 530-532 (titled dispatch classification) and 533-534 (untitled failure classification) | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: check_review_runs() classifies titled and untitled dispatch runs without verifying that head_branch is the default branch.
  WHY: A PR-controlled workflow can forge a titled successful run to mask a real failed review and enable auto-merge; an untitled failure from another branch can also affect other PRs.
- scripts/claude_fixer_pending_checks.py: lines 533-534 (untitled failure classification loop) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Failed untitled dispatches are collected without restricting them to the default branch.
  WHY: A failed dispatch from an unrelated branch can block pending_checks auto-merge for every PR whose marker is older than that run.
- scripts/claude_fixer_pending_checks.py: lines 548-552 (untitled failures check), interaction with 542-547 (newest bound review) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The untitled_failures check returns review_superseded even when a newer bound review succeeded.
  WHY: The successful bound review does not clear an older untitled failure, contrary to the latest-newer rule.
- scripts/claude_fixer_pending_checks.py: function signature at line 452, classification loop at 527-534, and caller at 659 | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: check_review_runs() has no default_branch parameter to gate trust in PR-controlled dispatch metadata.
  WHY: A forged successful run can be accepted as the latest review of another PR, masking a failure and enabling auto-merge.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: "Tests: the audit's scenario, every new path, the run-name wiring; existing #4900 / #5147 / #5148 suites green" (docs/implement-plan/issue-5906-bind-unbound-review-dispatches.md, Phase 1 bullet 3; docs/plans/issue-5906-bind-unbound-review-dispatches-plan.md, Tests section: "every new path")
  Expected change site: tests/test_claude_fixer_pending_checks.py, in test_an_unsuccessful_newer_review_supersedes_the_marker, test_settled_reviews_let_the_merge_through, or a new dedicated test
  Evidence of absence: The _titled() helper at line 482 hardcodes head_branch="main" unconditionally. Every free-form _run() call for untitled dispatches (lines 552-555, 559-560, 563-564, 596-597, 599-600) also passes head_branch="main". No test in the file drives a titled or untitled dispatch with head_branch set to a non-default-branch value (a PR-branch-controlled run) through check_review_runs to assert that the run is rejected for trust. The production code enforces no head_branch check for these dispatches, and no test exercisees the regression.
  confidence=5
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_8-flash ===
- scripts/claude_fixer_pending_checks.py: lines 527-534 | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: check_review_runs() binds workflow_dispatch runs to PRs using display_title without verifying head_branch == default_branch.
  WHY: A non-default branch can forge a run-name title for a target PR, and its newer success can mask a genuine review failure and allow unauthorized auto-merge.
- scripts/claude_fixer_pending_checks.py: lines 533-534 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Failed untitled workflow_dispatch runs are captured across all repository branches without verifying head_branch.
  WHY: A failed dispatch on an unrelated branch can block auto-merge for unrelated PRs whose markers predate the run.
- scripts/claude_fixer_pending_checks.py: lines 543-552 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: check_review_runs() evaluates untitled_failures after newer bound reviews and returns review_superseded even when a subsequent bound review succeeded.
  WHY: The older failure overrides a newer successful review, violating the latest-newer review invariant.
- scripts/claude_fixer_pending_checks.py: lines 452, 656, 659 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: check_review_runs() does not accept or verify default_branch, so it cannot enforce the trust boundary for dispatches.
  WHY: evaluate() computes default_branch but does not pass it to check_review_runs().
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: "Tests: the audit's scenario, every new path, the run-name wiring; existing #4900 / #5147 / #5148 suites green" (docs/plans/issue-5906-bind-unbound-review-dispatches-plan.md Phase 1 and PR description)
  Expected change site: tests/test_claude_fixer_pending_checks.py
  Evidence of absence: In tests/test_claude_fixer_pending_checks.py, the _titled() helper at line 482 hardcodes head_branch="main" for all titled dispatches, and all free-form dispatch runs in test_an_unsuccessful_newer_review_supersedes_the_marker (lines 552-564) and test_settled_reviews_let_the_merge_through (lines 596-600) set head_branch="main". No test exercises a titled or untitled dispatch with head_branch != "main" (such as a run executed on an untrusted branch) through check_review_runs() to verify that non-default branch dispatches cannot forge PR titles or cause spurious auto-merge blocks.
  confidence=5
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_8-flash ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- scripts/claude_fixer_pending_checks.py: lines 527-534 (the new `titled_dispatches` / `untitled_failures` loop) and the function signature at line 452 (no `default_branch` parameter) | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: check_review_runs() binds titled workflow_dispatch runs to PRs without verifying that head_branch is the trusted default branch.
  WHY: A PR-controlled branch can forge a successful run title, which can become the latest review and clear a real failed review.
- scripts/claude_fixer_pending_checks.py: lines 548-552 (the `if untitled_failures` block) following lines 543-547 (the bound `newer` check) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The untitled_failures check runs unconditionally after the bound-reviews pass, so an older untitled failure blocks a newer successful bound review.
  WHY: The older untitled failure can indefinitely block pending-checks merges even when a newer successful review has vetted the head.
- scripts/claude_fixer_pending_checks.py: lines 530-534 (the `for run in listing` loop populating `titled_dispatches` and `untitled_failures`) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Failed untitled dispatches from any branch are added to untitled_failures.
  WHY: A failed dispatch from any PR head branch can suppress auto-merge for every pending-checks PR whose marker is older.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: "Tests: the audit's scenario, every new path, the run-name wiring; existing #4900 / #5147 / #5148 suites green" (phase 1 description in `docs/plans/issue-5906-bind-unbound-review-dispatches-plan.md` and the Phase 1 bullets in `docs/implement-plan/issue-5906-bind-unbound-review-dispatches.md`).
  Expected change site: `tests/test_claude_fixer_pending_checks.py` — `_titled()` helper at line 482, the new parametrized cases in `test_an_unsuccessful_newer_review_supersedes_the_marker` (lines 537-565), `test_settled_reviews_let_the_merge_through` (lines 588-608), and a new test asserting that a titled or untitled dispatch from `head_branch != default_branch` is rejected for trust.
  Evidence of absence: The `_titled()` helper at line 482 unconditionally passes `head_branch="main"`; the free-form dispatch `_run()` calls at lines 552-555, 559-560, 563-564, 596-597, 599-600 also pass `head_branch="main"`. The only test in this file that varies `head_branch` for dispatched reviews is the older `test_default_branch_review_run_needs_the_full_dispatch_binding` at line 438, which targets `internal-review.yml` only. The `Copilot` review comment id 4152581553 explicitly flagged the gap at `scripts/claude_fixer_pending_checks.py:532`, and 6/6 reviewers in the consensus ledger re-flagged it. Without the missing test, the production regression (PR-branch forged run accepted as a bound review) is not caught by CI.
  confidence=5

  Expected change site: `scripts/claude_fixer_pending_checks.py` `check_review_runs()` — the `if untitled_failures` branch at lines 548-552.
